title: Product Vision Document
purpose: Define the proposed product, the outcome it seeks and the boundaries that protect that outcome.

title: Problem Statement and Value Proposition
purpose: State the failure to investigate and the proposed value for each party.

title: Product Requirements Document
purpose: Specify the user-facing MVP and its release conditions.

title: Software Requirements Specification
purpose: Define verifiable functional, operational and interface obligations.

title: Functional Requirements Document
purpose: Describe feature inputs, actor permissions, successful results and failure behaviour.

title: User Personas and User Stories
purpose: Define the people the MVP serves and the observable behaviours they need.

title: User Journeys and Workflow Diagrams
purpose: Show end-to-end behaviour, decision branches and recovery paths.

title: Feature Scope and MVP Prioritisation
purpose: Separate the essential release from later improvements.

title: System Architecture Document
purpose: Define component responsibilities and trust boundaries.

title: Technical Design Document
purpose: Specify module boundaries, write paths and concurrency behaviour.

title: Qloo API Integration Specification
purpose: Define the verified provider surface and the adapter contract to test with a live key.

title: AI Agent Architecture and Behaviour Specification
purpose: Define a bounded agent workflow with explicit authority and recovery.

title: Matching and Coalition Formation Algorithm Specification
purpose: Define deterministic feasibility, ranking and proposal generation.

title: Business Rules and Constraints Document
purpose: Provide the normative business invariants and state transitions.

title: Database Schema and Data Model
purpose: Define the proposed relational model, integrity rules and access strategy.

title: API Contracts and Interface Specifications
purpose: Specify application HTTP contracts independently from Qloo endpoints.

title: UI UX Design Specification
purpose: Define accessible screens and interactions for the proposed reservation workflow.

title: Design System and Component Library
purpose: Specify shared interface tokens and component behaviour.

title: Security Privacy and Data Handling Specification
purpose: Define data boundaries, access controls and proposed retention obligations.

title: Error Handling and Edge Cases
purpose: Specify recoverable failure behaviours and protected invariants.

title: Testing and Quality Assurance Plan
purpose: Define meaningful tests for product behaviour and failure recovery.

title: Evaluation Metrics and Benchmarking Plan
purpose: Test the product thesis and isolate the contribution of Qloo.

title: Deployment and Infrastructure Specification
purpose: Specify environments, secrets, job scheduling and release recovery.

title: Development Roadmap and Milestones
purpose: Provide a proposed build sequence with dependencies and release gates.

title: agents.md
purpose: Provide repository instructions for an implementation agent.

title: Definition of Done and Acceptance Criteria
purpose: Define the evidence required to call the MVP complete.

title: Assumptions Risks and Open Questions Register
purpose: Make unverified premises and implementation blockers visible.

title: Hackathon Submission and Demo Plan
purpose: Specify the proposed submission, judge experience and honest evidence.
